antennas.reads_as: 天线 A / Antenna A (scifi.outskirts:0): tallest silhouette, open lattice mast with two Yagi arrays and an amber beacon; jumpy amber spikes over a full four-bar readout, sparks off the array tip, a sensor-band placard with a machine glyph and patrol tread prints on the deck behind it = strongest but unreliable

天线 B / Antenna B (scifi.outskirts:1): wide parabolic dish on a turntable pedestal, smooth teal sine with two of four bars, an unbroken cable from the status box to a brass ground stake with a checked service tag = weaker but steady and intact

天线 C / Antenna C (scifi.outskirts:2): thin weathered (rusted) guyed mast under a bright new radome, amber wind ribbon, dropout readout, frost-crusted backup battery with one amber cell, the dull cracked old head on the deck = new head did not fix the wind/cold dropouts

foreground.rule: layer 13 as is, drawn at (0,0) above the heroine (z_index 1)
